skills.description: Structure, execute, and verify AI-assisted work with proportional task classification, clarification gates, evidence standards, file preservation, privacy controls, versioning, language routing, and acceptance criteria. Use for research, literature review, experimental design, data analysis, formal documents, multi-file changes, project planning, high-impact decisions, or requests where missing information, external actions, or unverified completion could materially affect the result. Also use when users ask to establish, initialize, audit, check, or improve an AI collaboration workflow or project rules; bundled local commands can install project rules, create task briefs, and check structural completeness.
